items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 7:49:1
items.html:
When the remaining lights came out there in order to enter their vessels, they were clothed in these posterior that had fallen: The matter of these posterior of AVI has already been explained, that they are all the discernments of Gadlut [greatness/adulthood] that were in AVI, from the discernment of face to back and from the discernment of face to face; all of this descended from the discernment of Rosh and became discernments of HGT lacking a Rosh. The reason is that their discernment of from above downward, which is the Guf — being the four kings, Daat and HGT, up to the upper third of Tifferet — broke and fell to BYA. Because of this the MAN [Mayin Nukvin] that had served in the Rosh were flawed as well, and they fell together with their lights and lost the illumination of Hochma that was in them, and received the discernments of HGT lacking a Rosh. Yet they did not descend on this account outside of Atzilut, as did the vessels of the ZAT, because the posterior of AVI that still remain above, of the discernments of back to back — that is, of what they had before the Gadlut — all of this remained in its full wholeness, as is known. And therefore the discernments of Gadlut of AVI that fell to HGT were likewise protected in those posterior of the back to back of the Rosh. However, there is a great difference from the discernment of AVI back to back that remained in the Rosh, for those that remained in the Rosh were never restricted because of the bottom Hey that is in the Einayim. But these discernments of Gadlut had already drawn the illumination of Hochma, and it departed from them once more because of the rise of the bottom Hey to the Einayim; they merely received the correction of the posterior of the Rosh after they had suffered a corruption. Therefore they are the discernment of receivers from the Rosh, and are considered Guf.
Even so, these posterior that fell to HGT are regarded as having become discernments of new vessels, corrected with the correction of lines like the AVI of the Rosh, and this is by force of their reception from the Rosh, as above. For the posterior of Ima corrects them with the correction of lines and binds them in a single bond. This means that the middle line, which is drawn in the light of Hassadim from the upper Bina, unites the right and the left and decides between them, also with her illumination of GAR. And all three lines are united in the bestowal of the light of Hassadim, since the upper ones too receive their wholeness through them. And you must remember here that the upper ones are Hesed and Gevura, which are in the relation of Hochma and Bina, and Tifferet is the secret of the lower one, which receives the light of Hassadim from the upper Bina, in whose clothing of the posterior there is the discernment of GAR, as above. Therefore Hesed and Gevura too, which need the illumination of GAR, are completed. Understand this well.
And it was explained above that the Rosh of YESHSUT clothes from the Chazeh of Nekudim up to the Peh [mouth] of the AVI of Nekudim. Thus the Rosh of YESHSUT clothes upon these posterior of AVI, which is comparable to the AVI of Atzilut, who clothe upon the HGT of the AA of Atzilut, those HGT bestowing all their wholeness upon the AVI of Atzilut, as is known. So too here, the posterior of AVI that fell to HGT became the internality of the Rosh of YESHSUT, from which it nurses its wholeness.
And this is what he says, “when the remaining lights came out there in order to enter their vessels, they were clothed in these posterior that had fallen, and the last kings came out clothed in the posterior of AVI.” For the lights of the Rosh of YESHSUT themselves were clothed in these posterior, since they clothe them within their internality, as above; and therefore their Gufim too, which are the four kings TNHYM, are likewise clothed in these posterior of AVI.
And you must know that there is a great distance between the posterior of AVI that fell and the Rosh of YESHSUT, for these posterior come from the discernment of the Rosh of AVI, except that because of the flaw of the breaking of the vessels they descended to HGT. And although the lights came out upon the screen of the NHY of AK, which are the discernments of ZON, nevertheless the MAN do not act at all in the Rosh, being there in the discernment of from below upward; and therefore these lights of Gadlut that came out upon the MAN are considered the discernment of AVI, and they are not included from the self of the bottom Hey. But the Rosh of YESHSUT, since it comes from the screen of the Guf of Nekudim, that is, from the screen of the Chazeh — these being the vessels and the lights that expanded from the MAN of the NHY of AK from above downward — the bottom Hey is essentially mixed into them. Therefore this YESHSUT would have clothed the HGT of Nekudim themselves, had they not broken. And so it turns out that this YESHSUT now gains a great deal, in that they clothe upon the posterior of Ima, which are in truth a higher degree than they; only because of their fall was it possible for YESHSUT to clothe them, as explained.

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 7:49:2
items.html: This remained with them always, until all the sortings finish coming out, until the End of Days, may it come speedily: That is to say, these posterior always become the discernments of the clothings of Mochin for the lights of ZON, by means of which ZA is able to attain all his degrees, and he is guarded by them. Were it not for these clothings, ZA would be unable to attain any Mochin at all, as written in its place. Therefore he needs them until the End of Days, that is, until he manages to attain all his degrees, which is at the end of correction.

items.html: The raising of MAN, etc., stems from the secret of these posterior of AVI that descended there, etc.: The matter of the raising of MAN [Mayin Nukvin] has already been explained above, that AVI do not couple face to face except through the raising of MAN (as written above, page 501, the passage beginning “The degree”). For since the upper Ima is with her posterior toward Aba, in the secret of “for He desires mercy,” she does not cease her posterior except through the raising of MAN by ZON, who awaken her to bestow upon them the illumination of Hochma; and for their sake she ceases her posterior and returns face to face with Aba. Study it there well. And since these posterior that fell from AVI already had within them the illumination of Hochma of ZON, having already been the discernment of Yechida, Haya and Neshama for the sake of ZON (as above, page 518, the passage beginning “For it was explained”). Study it there well. Therefore, when ZON rises as MAN, he again makes sortings from the Neshama, Haya and Yechida that are in these posterior, and raises them as MAN for himself to AVI. For when he raises the sortings of Neshama as MAN, that is, from that part of the posterior that had already served there in AVI in the discernment of the level of Bina, he is found to cause AVI a coupling of face to face of Neshama. And when he raises from the sortings of Haya, that is, from that part of the posterior that had already served there in AVI in the discernment of the level of Hochma, he is found to cause AVI to return face to face in the discernment of Haya. And likewise, for the need of Yechida, he raises from them the sortings of Yechida. Understand this.
